name: storage
title: Storage
description: R2-backed file storage for Lunora — direct-upload + worker-signed-URL helpers built on @lunora/storage over an R2 bucket binding, exposed as actions/queries so codegen surfaces them as api.storage.*.
docs: Add an R2 bucket named in wrangler.jsonc (binding UPLOADS) and set STORAGE_SIGNING_SECRET (>= 32 chars), then re-export the functions from lunora/storage/index.ts so codegen emits api.storage.generateUploadUrl / api.storage.getDownloadUrl / api.storage.deleteObject / api.storage.listObjects. Add the /storage/* route to your Worker entry — it verifies signed URLs and handles both the PUT the browser uploads with and the GET it downloads with (see the README).

envVars.name: STORAGE_SIGNING_SECRET
envVars.description: HMAC secret used to sign/verify storage URLs (min 32 chars). Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`. Must NOT be shared across buckets/tenants.

envVars.name: STORAGE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Optional override for the origin signed URLs point at. Leave it EMPTY and every URL is signed against the origin the request reached your Worker on (ctx.origin), which is right in dev, in previews and in production alike. Set it to a bare origin (no path: the key is verified from the whole URL pathname) when a CDN or another host serves the `/storage/*` route, or when URLs are signed where no request is behind the call (a query, a scheduled job, a workflow step), which otherwise throws.
